_readme: Ace Financial Services - AUM data, self-maintained (not a live feed). Update quarterly by checking https://www.amfiindia.com/aum-data/average-aum for each fund you want covered. 'aum_cr' is Average AUM in Rs Crore for the quarter shown in as_of_quarter. Key each fund by its AMFI scheme code (same code mfapi.in returns - visible in this site's own fund search results). Funds not listed here will simply show '-' on the site rather than breaking anything.
as_of_date: PLACEHOLDER - date you last updated this file, e.g. 2026-08-18
